title: Preset/favorite drag-and-drop and Favorites filtering do full config.json disk round-trips (including GZip of the entire host fleet) on the UI thread
existing_state: Seven hot handlers call _configService.Load() instead of GetCurrent(): ReorderFolders (Form1.cs:4946), ReorderPresetsInFolder (4954), InsertIntoFolderOrder (4973), InsertIntoPresetOrder (5010), RenamePresetInFolderOrder (5085), RefreshFavoritesList (5197), and ReorderFavoriteItems (5477) — only the constructor's Load at 349 is legitimate. ConfigurationService.Load() (Services/ConfigurationService.cs:46-103) re-reads config.json from disk, JSON-parses the whole file (all presets), and GZip-decompresses + deserializes the entire SavedState blob — which contains every host row of the fleet (ApplicationState.Hosts, Models/AppConfiguration.cs:348-358). The reorder handlers then call Save() (108-145), which copies a .bak, re-GZips the fleet, re-serializes the entire config with Formatting.Indented, and rewrites the file — all synchronously on the UI thread, once per drop during a drag-reorder session. RefreshFavoritesList additionally runs on every 150ms search-debounce tick while the Favorites tab is active (Form1.cs:9002-9010 -> 5197), so typing in the preset filter re-reads and re-inflates the whole config per tick. As a secondary hazard, Load() replaces _cachedConfig (ConfigurationService.cs:63) — the very instance that PresetManager (Services/PresetManager.cs:32-35, mutate-then-Save at 1024-1041) and Form1 itself (e.g. 3946) mutate via GetCurrent() — so any in-memory mutation not yet saved is silently discarded by the next reorder/refresh.
recommendation: Replace these Load() calls with _configService.GetCurrent() (the cache is always warm after the constructor's Load), or better, route the mutations through the existing ConfigurationService.Update(config => ...) API so read-modify-write is one code path and the cached instance is never swapped out from under other components. Reserve Load() for startup and explicit reload-from-disk actions.
user_benefit: Removes a per-drop disk read+gunzip+rewrite of the whole config (noticeable hitches when the fleet/preset set is large or the config dir is AV-scanned), and closes a lost-update window where unsaved in-memory config changes are silently thrown away by an unrelated tree reorder.

evidence.note: Load() = File.ReadAllText + full parse + gunzip of the fleet state + _cachedConfig replacement at line 63
Save() = .bak copy + re-GZip SavedState + indented full serialize + WriteAllText, synchronous
ApplicationState.Hosts holds the full fleet rows inside SavedState
150ms search debounce -> RefreshFavoritesList -> Load() per tick on the Favorites tab
PresetManager mutates the GetCurrent() instance — aliasing hazard when Load() swaps the cache
